votes.motion: Moved by Council Member Wharton, seconded by Council Member Dugan to enter into Closed Session for the purposes of advice of counsel relating to attorney client matters.
votes.description: The Council voted to enter into a closed session to receive attorney-client privileged legal advice from counsel.

votes.motion: Moved by Council Member Wharton, seconded by Council Member Dugan to exit Closed Session and adjourn.
votes.description: The Council voted to conclude the closed session and adjourn the meeting.
